address.description: Optional IP address used for the forwarding rule.

global_access.description: Allow client access from all regions.

group_configs.description: Optional unmanaged groups to create. Can be referenced in backends via key or outputs.

health_check_configs.description: Optional auto-created health check configurations, use the output self-link to set it in the auto healing policy. Refer to examples for usage.

http_proxy_config.description: HTTP proxy configuration. Only used for non-classic load balancers.

name.description: Override resource name derived from filename.

neg_configs.description: Optional network endpoint groups to create. Can be referenced in backends via key or outputs.

network_tier_premium.description: Use premium network tier. Defaults to true.

ports.description: Optional ports for HTTP load balancer.

protocol.description: Protocol supported by this load balancer.

region.description: The region where to allocate the ILB resources.

service_directory_registration.description: Service directory namespace and service used to register this load balancer.

ssl_certificates.description: SSL target proxy certificates (only if protocol is HTTPS).
